invariants.text: Customer.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Each customer must have a unique email address.
A customer's email address must be valid and follow the format of an email address.
The application must support creating a new customer with a name, email, and phone number.
The application must support retrieving a customer by their unique identifier.
The application must support updating an existing customer's name, email, or phone number.
The application must support deleting a customer by their unique identifier.
The application must support searching for customers by name using partial matching.
The application must support filtering customers by email domain (e.g., all customers with '@example.com').
Email addresses used in customer records must be stored in lowercase to ensure consistency.
If a customer with the same email address is attempted to be created, the operation must fail.
